item.title: Jewish Enrollment at Harvard Drops To Lowest Level Since Before WWII - The Jewish Link
item.description: (JNS) A new report by the Harvard Jewish Alumni Alliance found that Jewish undergraduate enrollment at Harvard University has dropped to about 7% in 2025, its lowest level since before World War II and the lowest among Ivy League schools with reliable data.
